chat.introParse: reads lab PDFs from unfamiliar labs and CT and MRI reports;
chat.introComment: comments on lab results and imaging studies and writes a monthly summary;
chat.introConsult: prepares visit questions and drafts the medical background;
chat.introChat: answers questions in this window, seeing your data and the open page.
chat.introKeys: You need your own key: OpenRouter, ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, YandexGPT, GigaChat, or your own model on a home server. Everything else works without AI, and this button won't appear again.
chat.disclaimer: Sees your profile, therapy, lab results, milestones, and the page that is open now. This is not a doctor: treatment decisions are made by a doctor.
chat.deep: Detailed (main model, slower and more expensive)

intro.lab_document: The model will look at the markers in this lab result, past values, and therapy, and write what to pay attention to. This is not medical advice.
intro.imaging_study: The model will explain the imaging report, the lesions, and the changes compared with past studies. This is not medical advice.
intro.note: The main model will read the note along with your profile and write what it is about, what applies to this case, what is doubtful, and what to ask a doctor. This is not medical advice.

ask.confirmClear: Delete the whole conversation ({n})? This can't be undone.
